blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — To secure consideration of her office’s proposed P785.2-million budget for 2027, Vice President Sara Duterte showed up at the Senate on Thursday. Her office’s proposed budget also sailed through plenary consideration in just two minutes without a single question from the senators. But she sidestepped reporters’ questions about facing the impeachment court, where she has yet to answer allegations of P817.87 million in unexplained and undeclared wealth. The Senate extended parliamentary courtesy to Duterte, allowing the proposed 2027 budget of the Office of the Vice President (OVP) to pass through plenary consideration, with no senator standing to interpellate […]...
